<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Game over again. Clicking bottom-row blocks ALWAYS causes game over.
# Green blocks regenerated (6 -> 17).
# 
# New hypothesis: 
# 1. Click ALL top-row green blocks to merge blue regions
# 2. Press ACTION7 (which might work differently when puzzle is solved)

# Reset first
result = action(['ACTION7'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")

# Separate top and bottom row blocks
top_blocks = []
bottom_blocks = []
for gn in green_nodes:
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    if center_r < 30:  # Top row
        top_blocks.append((center_r, center_c))
    else:  # Bottom row
        bottom_blocks.append((center_r, center_c))

print(f"Top blocks: {len(top_blocks)}")
print(f"Bottom blocks: {len(bottom_blocks)}")

# Click ALL top-row blocks
clicks = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in top_blocks]
print(f"\nClicking {len(clicks)} top-row blocks...")
result = action(clicks)

seg = current_frame.segmentation
blue_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"Blue regions: {len(blue_nodes)}")
for bn in blue_nodes:
    b = bn['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
    print(f"  rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c}")

green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Remaining green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")

# Now try ACTION7
print("\nTrying ACTION7...")
result = action(['ACTION7'])
print(f"Result: level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Score: {last_action_result.get('score')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
